issues.title: Slow reads and a new challenge
issues.summary: Two books people can't put down, four accounts worth a follow, and the September photo challenge.
issues.body: Hello, and welcome to the first Micro Wrapped. The idea is simple: once a week, a short note on what's happening around Micro.blog, a few things worth reading, and some picks. Nothing here is automated. If it's in this edition it's because someone on Micro.blog was talking about it.

notes.links: Three pages that explain more of Micro.blog than most people ever find. The first one is the reason the timeline looks the way it does.
notes.books: September is a reading month. Two novels keep coming up in the [books timeline](https://micro.blog/discover/books), one long and one you can finish in an evening. If you've not tried the Books tab yet, add one of them to Want to Read and see how the shelves work.
notes.people: If you're new, these are the accounts to follow first. They'll tell you what's changing on the platform before anyone else does.
notes.watching: Three shows people kept posting about this week. Tap one and the app searches for it so you can say what you're watching.
notes.tip: The photo challenge is back. The prompts come from [@challenges](https://micro.blog/challenges), one a day, and you take part by posting a photo with the day's tag. It's the easiest way to meet people here. See you next week.
